# WP-2402 - Pilot submission preparation

## Current pilot handoff

Current installation: `.local/pilot-v14`,198 canonical migrations; branch
`codex/wp-2402-pilot-submission`, HEAD `a0f35440cacff1ab55be78edfb08cb4de90c1a26`
plus the existing uncommitted WP implementation. No complete-pilot or release approval.
Use [current acceptance and remaining work](../../runbooks/single-store-pilot.md#current-acceptance-and-remaining-work)
for the consolidated flow status. The chronological batch records at the end carry
individual commands, results and evidence limitations.

- 571 completes a new persisted Dining sale, Kitchen/serving, actual employee refund,
  originalGuest rendered Original/Refund receipts and normal Order/Session closure/table release.
- 554–556 complete automatic simulated late-payment compensation and operator reconciliation.
- 572–573 read two complete Store days through2026-09-21, both Matched, and add read-only
  settlement handover status. Independent exceptions and the initial partial day remain separate.
- 561/563 prove worker process recovery and enable continuous local supervision with maintenance
  exclusion;569 proves supervisor stale-lock cleanup.574 adds maintenance-owner diagnosis, without
  claiming automatic recovery of interrupted Docker backup/restore operations.
- 564–568 implement scoped assignee candidates, protected HTTP and UI pagination.
  Broader employee identity remains a future gate;598accepts the existing DEMO account
  for the current Windows/WSL phase.
- 575–587 complete recorded assembled type/lint/build/unit/browser, structural,
  selected persisted integrations and frozen-install evidence. Later scoped changes
  use their recorded affected checks; these results are not real Store release approval.
- 596–597 prove actual interrupted Docker restore containment and reviewed original-source
  resumption. Cloud/fresh-host and OS-reboot provisioning remain later deployment work.
- 600–601 establish trusted Windows HTTPS and Owner-observed entry to the DEMO workspace.
- 602 records current operating work;604 fixes the unknown Dining row as authoritative
  Cancelled/version2, with no acceptance action and actual current HTTPS evidence.

Current local milestone: the Owner-selected assisted InternalTest operation has now
completed a new Pickup journey through confirmed handoff and persisted receipt (618–619),
with earlier Dining/refund evidence retained. The before-start interrupted resume-controller
exercise passed in615; other crash phases retain their stated limits.620reconciles current
candidate inputs and source evidence. Independent operator takeover was explicitly declined
in616and must not be fabricated or repeatedly required for assisted use. This is not
real Store/Provider activation or a formal release approval. Those conditions remain subject to the
[external readiness inventory](../../runbooks/pilot-integration-readiness-inventory.md).

Synthetic facts/configuration must stay isolated and labeled non-production; do not write fake Verified/Pass production approvals or disable production checks. User authorizes these test configurations now, so the earlier request for real Store materials is no longer a blocker to this milestone.
Required delivered flow: browser-created Dining and immediate Pickup orders, simulated payment, staff acceptance, Kitchen preparation, served or handed-off quantities and current order status, persistent across refresh. Preserve exact Money/quantity, idempotency, basic inventory/capacity, authorization and durable state. Reuse already implemented receipt/refund where easily assembled; otherwise mark unavailable and list deferred. Never expose enabled inert controls or fabricated success.
Deferred: real payment/KYC/legal/live Store gates, external deployment, advanced menu options, generic publication/approval administration, scheduled Pickup, reporting and cosmetic refinement. Receipt/refund/close-table not wired into this internal build may be explicitly unavailable rather than blocking core flow. Existing no commit/push/merge/deploy/real-payment authorization remains.
Next work priority: configure long-lived API, Customer frontend, Merchant/Kitchen frontend and necessary Workers using smallest isolated test setup and existing owner services/adapters. No new general framework. Existing .local/pilot-v4 database/182 migrations and private connection setup are candidate resources; b9b8cd confirms business grants and application composition not installed. Keep prior candidates/data intact. Do not substitute static demo, health-only runtime or temporary test server.

Required final internal milestone is at least one original browser-created Dining and one original browser-created immediate Pickup processed by staff against persistent DB, followed by refresh/restart read evidence. Affected configuration/permissions/runtime checks only, no repeated fullverify. Deliver actual accessible addresses, test identity/entry procedure, shortest walkthrough, open functions and known limitations.
